name: Embodied Presences raises Presence proc chance and halves their mana cost (#3321)
contract: Embodied Presences 803283 (Spell.dbc, passive, family 31) has two effects sharing class mask dword A bit9 (512) + dword C bit6 (64). effect0 is SPELLMOD_FLAT (107) on SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS (misc 18), BasePoints 4+1=+5 (percentage points). effect1 is SPELLMOD_PCT (108) on SPELLMOD_COST (misc 14), BasePoints -51+1=-50%. That combined mask independently name-matches the Cultist's actually-granted Presence spells (modules/mod-ascension-compat/src/AscensionCultistData.h CultistEvents[]): Presence of Y'Shaarj (803035) and Presence of N'Zoth (803037) both carry SpellFamilyFlags [16384,0,64] (dword C bit6 matches), and Presence of C'Thun (803339) carries the same [16384,0,64] -- confirmed here by DBC lookup, upgrading the chunk7 investigator's 'medium confidence, not name-verified' note to high. (Two other same-named DBC rows, 803038 and 803355/801560, exist with different flags but are absent from CultistEvents[] and are not live Cultist grants.) Both spellmods are stock ops read generically by the engine wherever it rolls proc chance (SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS) or computes power cost (SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost, SPELLMOD_COST) for the affected spell; no CoA script or dummy handler exists for 803283 anywhere in modules/mod-ascension-compat or src/server/game. spell_power_cost proves the -50% mana cost directly and deterministically; the +5%-proc-chance clause has no scenario metric that reads a raw SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS total without an actual proc roll, so it is asserted via spell_modifier (op 18) against an arbitrary base instead of an unreliable repeated-roll count, avoiding a coin-flip assertion. A control spell outside the mask (Netherstrike 806222) must be unaffected by both mods. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively; no code change.
